title: Multiscale Detection of Localized Counterfactual Density Shifts under Rough Unknown Propensity
banked_reason: D-0.5 NO-PASS after four field-tier REVISE verdicts: active stat_causal_witness_balanced_frontier already packages the same exact-null multiscale frontier, observable higher-order scan, common scan, and selected-scale band; unequal-smoothness extension alone is not yet a distinct novelty kernel.
gap_reasons: Its balanced exact-null collision frontier substantially duplicates the active stat_causal_witness_balanced_frontier lower and matched-frontier kernel rather than establishing a distinct problem.

The active stat_causal_witness_balanced_frontier already packages the same exact-null multiscale frontier, observable higher-order scan, common scan, and selected-scale band; unequal-smoothness extension alone is not yet a distinct novelty kernel.

Each is conditional on a D0 certificate explicitly required by the OEQ to prove respectively constant common inflation and matched simultaneous-band width, so its conditional headline largely restates the assumed certificate.
proof_attempt_summary: Four D-0.5 field-tier proposal revisions attempted to distinguish the multiscale causal density frontier from an active balanced-smoothness run. A consult-derived balanced specialization, unequal-smoothness plateau candidate, corrected comparators, and model-semantics repairs did not clear the recurring novelty overlap; no D0 derivation or Lean proof began. A future re-raise needs a genuinely distinct asymmetric finite-rank observable D0 process theorem with proved active-face tails, rather than another conditional scan or band package.
tldr: Localized marginal causal density shifts have a revealed-propensity frontier with scan face \([\log(\mathrm e/h)/(nh)]^{1/2}\) and fine-scale plateau \((\log n/n)^{\beta/(2\beta+1)}\), while exact marginal-null mixtures force an additional collision program under an unknown rough propensity. The unconditional strict nuisance theorem holds for \(s+\gamma<1/2\). The candidate matched frontier is \(R_n(h)=\max\{R_n^{\mathrm{known}}(h),D_{0,n}(h)\}\), with every balanced-slice face explicit; observable attainment, the \(s+\gamma=1/2\) logarithms, constant common inflation, and matched selected-scale band width are the named D0 open obligation rather than asserted consequences.
gap: Published global kernel equality tests, counterfactual-density risk results, fixed-location witness inference, and uniform density bands do not characterize the shrinking-location, shrinking-bandwidth all-measurable-test radius under a rough unknown propensity. KBW (2023) does not supply that frontier.
fill: The project combines legal balanced-versus-aligned mixtures, an independently checkable direct-density corollary, an explicit balanced D0 slice, and a concrete higher-order process handle; constant inflation and matched selected-scale width are conditional targets of the D0 certificate. Componentwise Hölder slacks and an extension-defined observed-data model make lower-family legality and causal identification separate supporting claims.
